Verses.1: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth.
Verses.2:
LORD, I have heard what You proclaimed, and was seized by fear.
LORD, revive Your work in our years.
Make it known in the midst of years.
In wrath, remember mercy.
Verses.3:
God comes from Teman.
The Holy One from Mount Paran.
selah
His splendor covers the heavens,
and His praise fills the earth.
Verses.5:
Plague goes before Him.
Pestilence follows His footsteps.

Changes: 2025-01-18 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of verses 1-5.
